notes: rule 11: the saying turns on a narrated encounter («اسْتَقْبَلْتُهُ» ... «فَقَالَ إِنِّي لَمْ أُصَلِّ») whose speaker is not named in the text, and on a second isnad inside the story («أَخْبَرَنِي فُلَانٌ عَنْ فُلَانٍ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ»); the route is written to ليث بن أبي سليم only
«أخيه علي» is one link, the name alone (rule 7); «فُلانٌ» is a placeholder, not a name, left out
